posts.title: Carta a los accionistas de Porta Norte 2026
posts.description: Versión pública de la carta que le escribo cada año a los accionistas de Porta Norte, tras la Junta de agosto de 2026: la escuela, el Peñón, Portavita y el puente que cruza el río. The post Carta a los accionistas de Porta Norte 2026 appeared first on Henry Faarup .

posts.title: Porta Norte 2026 Shareholder Letter
posts.description: Every year, after the shareholders' meeting, I write to Porta Norte's shareholders. This is the 2026 letter, public version: the school, El Peñón, Portavita and the bridge across the river. The post Porta Norte 2026 Shareholder Letter appeared first on Henry Faarup .

posts.title: The Porta Norte Charrette
posts.description: On August 11, 2015, Andres Duany and DPZ presented the Master Plan of Ciudad Porta Norte at the American Trade Hotel, after an eight-day charrette in Casco Viejo. The full chronicle, with drawings, diagrams and photos. The post The Porta Norte Charrette appeared first on Henry Faarup .
